_README: gosec configuration for the blocking `gosec` job in .github/workflows/security.yml.
The job runs WITHOUT `-no-fail`: any finding not suppressed here fails CI.
Every suppression below is a reviewed decision, not a convenience. Keys
beginning with `_` are annotations; gosec ignores them.
The job is also invoked with `-exclude-generated`, which drops the two G103
(`unsafe` usage) hits in pb/v1/kv.pb.go. That file is produced by
protoc-gen-go from proto/pallasdb/v1/kv.proto and is never hand-edited; the
and `gosec ./...` with no config to see the raw, unsuppressed set.

G115: "integer overflow conversion" — 23 hits, concentrated in db/cell.go,
cluster/fsm_snapshot.go. These are the binary encode/decode sites: the
engine's on-disk format is fixed-width little-endian, so every read and
write legitimately converts between int/uint32/uint64 and back. gosec
flags the conversion itself, not a reachable overflow; the widths are
checked by the record-length and CRC validation that surrounds them.
Suppressed at the rule level because a per-site #nosec would touch ~23
lines of hot encoding code for no behavioural gain.
G304: cmd/pallasdb/local_benchmark.go:672). Opening a caller-supplied path is
the entire contract of an embedded storage engine: db.NewKV(path) and
`local benchmark --output` take the path from the operator running the
process. There is no untrusted-input boundary here to defend.
G104: hash.Hash.Write. The hash.Hash interface documents that Write never
returns an error, so the call sites are correct. errcheck/errorlint in
the golangci `lint-strict` job cover genuine unchecked errors far more
precisely than gosec's G104, which is why the rule as a whole is off

G301: Default is 0750. The threshold is relaxed to 0755 for the data and
benchmark directories created in db/kv.go and
cmd/pallasdb/local_benchmark.go, so that an operator can inspect a data
directory without becoming the service user. Those directories hold no
secrets; TLS material is supplied by path and is never written by the
process. The raft directory (cluster/node.go) is deliberately tighter
at 0750 — it holds the log store and snapshots — and passes under this
threshold unchanged. If the data and benchmark directories are ever
tightened too, delete this relaxation rather than keeping it around.
G302: Default is 0600. Data files (db/os_unix.go, db/sorted_file.go) and the
benchmark output file are created 0644 for the same reason. Threshold
relaxed to 0644 — this still fails on group/other-writable modes.
